rows.title: National Latino Physician Day Celebration
rows.description:
🌺🩺 ¡LMSA Familia! Join us in celebrating National Latino Physician Day! 🩺🌺
UCR School of Medicine invites you to a special day celebrating Latino physicians, culture, community, and the power of representation in medicine. ❤️
Come hear inspiring stories from Latino physicians and leaders, connect with our community, and enjoy a day filled with music, dancing, lunch, and an exhibitor fair! 💃🏽🎶🌮
✨ Featuring keynote speakers: Dr. Margarita Loeza Dr. David Hayes-Bautista Katherine Flores, M.D.
🎤 Physician Share Out: Dr. Michael Galvez, Co-Founder of the National Latino Physician Day Movement
📅 Saturday, October 3rd ⏰ 10 AM – 2 PM 📍 UCR School of Medicine, Building II, Room 104 🍽️ Lunch provided!
Latinos make up a vital part of the communities we serve, yet only 6% of physicians are Latino. Representation matters — and 6% is not enough. ✊🏽🩺
💐 Come celebrate our heritage, connect with Latino physicians, and envision the future of Latinos in medicine. Register using the QR code on the flyer! 
#NationalLatinoPhysicianDay #NLPD #LMSA #UCRSOM #LatinosInMedicine LatinoPhysicians RepresentationMatters FuturePhysicians LMSAFamilia UCRiverside
rows.location: UCR School of Medicine, Building II, Room 104

rows.title: Crosstown Showdown Women's Soccer: UCR vs. CBU
rows.description:
The University of California, Riverside and California Baptist University are going head-to-head in the new Crosstown Showdown, a yearlong competition across multiple Division I sports in the Big West Conference.

It all starts September 26 with women’s soccer at UCR, as the Lancers and Highlanders begin competing for points toward the Crosstown Showdown Championship Trophy.

 The competition builds on Riverside’s proud roots as a sports town, where generations of athletes have developed their talents and inspired community pride.

rows.description:
We are just three weeks away from the annual Celebration of Women in Medicine and Science, featuring a keynote address by Alison Whelan, chief academic officer of the Association of American Medical Colleges. It will also feature a panel discussion facilitated by Monica Carson, PhD, chair of the Division of Biomedical Sciences and remarks from UCR Provost Elizabeth Watkins, PhD.
